title: EROC IPO lockup ends — ERock, 180 days after its 2026-06-09 prospectus
source: EST: the filing states more than one lock-up period (30, 180 days; this date uses 180, the one its lock-up sentences name most). 424B4 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2110029/000119312526265898/d12401d424b4.htm, fetched 2026-10-20 (scripts/research/lockup-discovery.mjs). Prospectus dated 2026-06-09 (read from its cover); 180 days after it is 2026-12-06. Lock-up clause: "We, our directors and executive officers, and the holders of substantially all of our Class A and Class B common stock will enter into lock-up agreements pursuant to which we and they will be subject to certain restrictions with respect to the sale or other disposition of our Class A common stock or securities conve…"
notes: $600M offering. Insiders may sell from the next session; the pullback the lockup-expiry playbook studies (#5912) is the supply that unlocks then.
